limitations.note: The counter-wrap fix was correct, but removing the `ready_b` guard also changed how `data_out` updates when the first input of a group is accepted while downstream is stalled.

The scoreboard unconditionally started each group from zero, so the stalled-start test validated the agent's new behavior rather than checking whether the original `ready_b`-dependent behavior was preserved.
